answer.rationale: Run a guarded referral test among established customers to pursue qualified revenue without copying the competitor’s price cuts. Prior referral evidence showed revenue gains without measurable retention harm, although its archived source should be verified next cycle. Avoid promotional pricing: recovered evidence showed that a 40% targeted SMB discount lifted acquisition and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, conflicting with the sustainable-growth objective. Keep the test small because the referral result may not fully generalize to today’s competitive conditions.
